document_api_meta.title: Create Promotion Activity
document_api_meta.env_desc: Create a fixed-price, percentage-off, flash sale, shipping-discount, Buy More Save More, Gift With Purchase, or Buy X Get Y promotion activity. Coupons cannot be created with this API; create them in Seller Center or the seller app. To update the products or SKUs included in the activity, use [Update Activity Product](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650d32c42aaa3602b86ccb5c).

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: title
request_body_param.desc: Unique name across all your activities. Maximum length: 50 characters for `FLASHSALE` and `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT`; 100 characters for `FIXED_PRICE`, `DIRECT_DISCOUNT`, `BUY_MORE_SAVE_MORE`, `BUY_X_GET_Y`, and `GIFT_WITH_PURCHASE`.

request_body_param.name: activity_type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of promotion activity.
Possible values:
- `FIXED_PRICE`: A product discount activity with a fixed price.
- `DIRECT_DISCOUNT`: A product discount activity with a percentage discount.
- `FLASHSALE`: A flash sale activity.
- `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT`: A shipping fee discount activity.
- `BUY_MORE_SAVE_MORE`: A Buy More Save More promotion.
- `GIFT_WITH_PURCHASE`: A Gift With Purchase promotion.
- `BUY_X_GET_Y`: A Buy X Get Y promotion.

request_body_param.name: product_level
request_body_param.desc:
The product scope of the activity.
Possible values:
- `PRODUCT`: Apply the promotion at the product (SPU) level to all SKUs in each selected product.
- `VARIATION`: Apply the promotion only to selected SKUs.
- `SHOP`: Apply the promotion to all products in the shop.

Activity-specific constraints:
- `FIXED_PRICE`, `DIRECT_DISCOUNT`, and `FLASHSALE` support `PRODUCT` or `VARIATION`.
- `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT` does not support `VARIATION`.
- `BUY_MORE_SAVE_MORE` and `BUY_X_GET_Y` support `PRODUCT` or `SHOP`.
- `GIFT_WITH_PURCHASE` requires `PRODUCT`.

To set the products or SKUs covered by the activity, use [Update Activity Product](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650d32c42aaa3602b86ccb5c).

request_body_param.name: duration_type
request_body_param.desc:
The effective time type of the current activity
- NORMAL:  `begin_time` and `end_time` must be filled
- INDEFINITE: `begin_time` and `end_time` aren't required, and the promotion will be a long-term activity which runs indefinitely. 
1.  `INDEFINITE` is only valid when `activity_type` is `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT`,
2. If `duration_type` is `INDEFINITE`, `start_time` and `end_time` should be 0
Default: NORMAL

request_body_param.name: begin_time
request_body_param.desc: Activity start time. UNIX timestamp. The value must be greater than the value of the current time.

request_body_param.name: end_time
request_body_param.desc: Activity end time as a Unix timestamp in seconds. For `NORMAL` `FIXED_PRICE`, `DIRECT_DISCOUNT`, `FLASHSALE`, `BUY_MORE_SAVE_MORE`, `BUY_X_GET_Y`, and `GIFT_WITH_PURCHASE` activities, it must be at least 600 seconds after `begin_time`. For a `NORMAL` shipping-discount activity, provide a positive value.

request_body_param.name: participation_limit
request_body_param.desc: Buyer participation-limit settings. For `BUY_MORE_SAVE_MORE`, `BUY_X_GET_Y`, and `GIFT_WITH_PURCHASE`, provide exactly one entry.

request_body_param.name: ^type
request_body_param.desc:
Determines whether each buyer can receive the activity benefit more than once.
Possible values:
- `BUYER_NO_LIMIT`: A buyer can benefit from this activity across multiple orders.
- `BUYER_LIMIT_ONLY_ONE`: A buyer can benefit from this activity for no more than one order.

request_body_param.name: discount
request_body_param.desc: Discount configuration. For `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT`, provide `shipping_discount`; for `BUY_MORE_SAVE_MORE`, provide `bmsm_discount`; for `GIFT_WITH_PURCHASE`, provide `gift_discount`; and for `BUY_X_GET_Y`, provide `bxgy_discount`. This field is not used for `FIXED_PRICE`, `DIRECT_DISCOUNT`, or `FLASHSALE`.

request_body_param.name: ^shipping_discount
request_body_param.desc: Configurations for the shipping discount, including purchase criteria, discount value, shipping method, inventory type, and area scope.

request_body_param.name: ^^threshold_type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of purchase criteria. Possible enumerations are:
- `NO_THRESHOLD`: No minimum purchase criteria. 
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order.
`MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY` and `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT` can only be set when `product_level==SHOP`.

request_body_param.name: ^^threshold_value
request_body_param.desc:
The purchase threshold of the discount, based on `threshold_type`, for example, `3`. Determined by the user.
- When `threshold_type==NO_THRESHOLD`, this value is not required.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, the buyer must purchase at least the specified number of eligible products (for example, 3 eligible products). If it represents a quantity, it must be an integer.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, the eligible-product subtotal must meet or exceed the specified value in local currency (for example, 3 units of local currency). If it represents an order value, it must be limited to two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^type
request_body_param.desc:
The shipping benefit type.
- `FREE_SHIPPING`: Reduce the buyer's shipping fee to zero.
- `DISCOUNT_SHIPPING_FEE`: Reduce the buyer's shipping fee by up to the amount specified in `shipping_discount.value`.

request_body_param.name: ^^value
request_body_param.desc:
The shipping discount value determined by `type`.
- When `type==FREE_SHIPPING`, omit this value.
- When `type==DISCOUNT_SHIPPING_FEE`, enter the maximum amount deducted from the buyer's shipping fee in local currency, with at most two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^shipping_method
request_body_param.desc:
The shipping methods to which this promotion applies.
- When `STANDARD_SHIPPING`: Only applies to Standard Shipping methods, including Economy.
- `EXPRESS_SHIPPING`: Only applies to Express Shipping methods.
- `ALL_SHIPPING_METHOD`: Applies to all shipping methods that the shop offers.
Default: `STANDARD_SHIPPING`

request_body_param.name: ^^inventory_type
request_body_param.desc:
The inventory types to which the promotion activity applies:
- `SELF_FULFILLED`: Only applies to Inventory fulfilled from seller warehouses
- `FULFILLED_BY_TIKTOK`: Only applies to Inventory fulfilled by TikTok from FBT (Fulfilled by TikTok) warehouses.
- `ALL`:  Applies to all inventory of eligible products.
Default: `SELF_FULFILLED`
`FULFILLED_BY_TIKTOK` and `ALL` can only be set when `product_level`==`SHOP` and `threshold_type=NO_THRESHOLD`.

request_body_param.name: ^^area_scope
request_body_param.desc: The (buyer's) geographical areas to which the promotion activity applies.

request_body_param.name: ^^^type
request_body_param.desc:
The (buyer's) geographical area to which the promotion activity applies.
​- `WHOLE`: Promotion activity applies to all areas to which the seller offers fulfillment. 
- `SPECIFIC_AREAS`: Only applies to specific fulfillment areas, as defined in `area_scope.specific_areas`

request_body_param.name: ^^^specific_areas
request_body_param.desc: The list of areas for which the promotion activity applies. The valid values that may be included in this list are dependent on the region of the shop. The list of valid values for each shop region are available here: [link](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/67e3b059e7dc4f04a4ff9e09)

request_body_param.name: ^bmsm_discount
request_body_param.desc: Configurations related to Buy More Save More (BMSM) promotions

request_body_param.name: ^^details
request_body_param.desc: Configurations for Buy More Save More tiers. Provide one or two tiers. `threshold_type` and `type` must be the same across all tiers.

request_body_param.name: ^^^tier
request_body_param.desc: `tier` uses 1-based indexing: the first and second tiers are `1` and `2`, not `0` and `1`. For each subsequent tier, both `threshold_value` and `value` must be greater than those of the previous tier. For example, if tier `1` has `threshold_value` `20` and `value` `15`, tier `2` must have a `threshold_value` greater than `20` and a `value` greater than `15`.

request_body_param.name: ^^^threshold_type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of purchase criteria. Possible enumerations are:
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order.

request_body_param.name: ^^^threshold_value
request_body_param.desc:
The purchase threshold for this tier.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, enter a positive integer.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, enter a positive amount in local currency, with at most two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^^type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of discount awarded as a benefit. The value of the discount is determined by `value`.
Possible enumerations are:
- `PERCENTAGE_OFF`: Buyer will receive X% off the price of the eligible products.
- `AMOUNT_OFF`: Buyer will receive X units of local currency off the price of eligible products.

request_body_param.name: ^^^value
request_body_param.desc:
The discount value.
- When `type==PERCENTAGE_OFF`, enter a positive integer percentage.
- When `type==AMOUNT_OFF`, enter a positive amount in local currency, with at most two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^gift_discount
request_body_param.desc: Configurations related to Gift With Purchase (GWP) promotions. Only needs to be configured for GWP promotions.

request_body_param.name: ^^gift_receiving_type
request_body_param.desc:
The receiving type of gift. Currently only one type is supported:
- `ALL_RECEIVE`: All gifts configured in the promotion can be collected.

request_body_param.name: ^^gift_infos
request_body_param.desc: Gift With Purchase tier configurations. Provide at least one tier. A maximum of two tiers is permitted in SEA and the UK, while only one tier is permitted in the US. `threshold_type` must be the same across all tiers.

request_body_param.name: ^^^tier
request_body_param.desc:
`tier` uses 1-based indexing, i.e. the first and second tiers are counted "1, 2", not "0, 1".
`threshold_value` for a given tier must be greater than that of the previous tier. 
E.g. If `tier`==1 has `threshold_value`==`2`, `tier`==2 must have `threshold_value` > `2`.

request_body_param.name: ^^^threshold_type
request_body_param.desc:
The purchase threshold type of discount. Possible enumerations are:
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order.

request_body_param.name: ^^^threshold_value
request_body_param.desc:
The purchase threshold for the gift, determined by `threshold_type`.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, enter a positive integer number of eligible products.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, enter a positive eligible-product subtotal in local currency, with at most two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^^gift_details
request_body_param.desc: The gift SKUs for this tier. Across all tiers, provide at least one gift SKU in total, and do not repeat the same sku_id anywhere in the activity. For a MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY tier, this list must not be empty.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^product_id
request_body_param.desc: TikTok Shop product id of gift.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^sku_id
request_body_param.desc: TikTok Shop sku id of gift.

request_body_param.name: ^^^^total_claim_limit
request_body_param.desc: The total claim limit for the gift SKU in this activity. Enter an integer from `1` to `99999`.

request_body_param.name: ^bxgy_discount
request_body_param.desc: Configurations related to Buy X Get Y (BXGY) promotions. Only needs to be configured for BXGY promotions.

request_body_param.name: ^^threshold_type
request_body_param.desc:
The purchase criterion.
Possible values:
- `MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`: The buyer must purchase at least the configured quantity of eligible products.
- `MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`: The eligible-product subtotal must reach the configured amount.

request_body_param.name: ^^threshold_value
request_body_param.desc:
The purchase threshold determined by `threshold_type`.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY`, enter a positive integer no greater than `10`.
- When `threshold_type==MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT`, enter a positive eligible-product subtotal in local currency, with at most two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^discount_type
request_body_param.desc:
The type of benefit.
Possible values:
- PERCENTAGE_OFF: Apply the percentage specified by discount_value to eligible products.
- FREE: Provide the configured quantity of eligible products for free.
- AMOUNT_OFF_EACH: Deduct the local-currency amount specified by discount_value from each eligible product.

request_body_param.name: ^^discount_value
request_body_param.desc:
Value of the discount.
- When `type`==`PERCENTAGE_OFF`, the buyer will receive X% off the price of eligible products. If the value represents a percentage, it should be an integer.
- `type`==`AMOUNT_OFF_EACH`, the buyer will receive X units of local currency off the price of each eligible products. If the value represents a monetary amount, it should be limited to two decimal places.

request_body_param.name: ^^benefit_max_applicable_quantity
request_body_param.desc: The quantity of item Y awarded each time the Buy X Get Y benefit applies. Enter a positive integer no greater than `20`.

request_body_param.name: ^^benefit_max_applicable_times
request_body_param.desc: Optional. The maximum number of times the Buy X Get Y benefit can be applied in one order. Enter a positive integer no greater than `50`.

request_body_param.name: target_user_info
request_body_param.desc: Target-audience configuration for `BUY_MORE_SAVE_MORE`, `BUY_X_GET_Y`, and `GIFT_WITH_PURCHASE` activities. If omitted, the activity targets `ALL_USER`.

request_body_param.name: ^user_type
request_body_param.desc:
Possible enumerations are:
`ALL_USER`
`SHOP_NEW_CUSTOMER`
`SHOP_EXISTING_CUSTOMER`
`SHOP_REPEAT_CUSTOMER`

request_body_param.name: auction_support_type
request_body_param.desc:
For `SHIPPING_DISCOUNT` activities, determines whether auction products are supported.
Possible values:
- `ALL`: Support both regular and auction products.
- `EXCLUDE_AUCTION`: Exclude auction products.
Default: `ALL`.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: ^activity_id
response_param.desc: On success, the ID of the created activity. Use it as `activity_id` when adding products or SKUs with [Update Activity Product](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650d32c42aaa3602b86ccb5c).

response_param.name: ^create_time
response_param.desc: The time when the activity was created.

response_param.name: ^update_time
response_param.desc: The time when the activity was last updated.

response_param.name: ^status
response_param.desc:
Possible values:
- DRAFT: Promotion activities with this status are not available to TikTok users.
- NOT_START: Promotion activities with this status are not available to TikTok users until the set activity start time.
- ONGOING: Promotion activities with this status are available to TikTok users.
- EXPIRED: Promotion activities with this status are not available to TikTok users because it has expired.
- DEACTIVATED: The activity has been deactivated by the seller and is not available to TikTok users.
- NOT_EFFECTIVE:  The activity is terminated by the platform and is not available to TikTok users.
